fields.summary_ko.0: Micron (MU) fell 4% on Kioxia's weak December quarter guidance, with monthly decline of 20%; Western Digital (WDC) down 5% and SanDisk down 3% in sympathy.
fields.summary_ko.1: Kioxia CFO attributed weak outlook to shipping timing issues, noting AI demand remains solid with 2027 production fully sold.
